lesson.title: Procedure 400 – 10-13 INCIDENTS
objectives: Identify who the 10-13 code applies to and why it is critical.
Apply the required dispatching methods for 10-13 incidents received via radio or 911.
Control radio traffic and unit assignments during foot pursuits, vehicle pursuits, and police involved shootings.
Handle special 10-13 events (alarms at police facilities, suicidal MOS) per Procedure 400.

questions.stem: Procedure 400: What is the general nature of a 10-13 incident for a dispatcher?

choices.text: Rapid-paced incident with multiple units responding and simultaneous radio traffic
Non-urgent call that can be queued

questions.hints: Look for wording about pace and number of units.
